updates: Adopted major.minor version numbers, continuing the atlas as v1.5.
Made the version and date label open a changelog with collapsible entries.
Added a concise history of changes from the previous four releases.
Expanded the taxon catalog from 100 to 200 profiles.
Tightened spacing, switched displayed ages from mya to Ma, and simplified hierarchy controls.
Moved Earth-shaping Events above the Evolutionary Lens and limited visible taxa to nine.
Merged climate and geology into a richer Overview and added illustrative continental maps.
Expanded the catalog from 50 to 100 taxon profiles.
Integrated new taxa into geologic intervals, search, and detail views.
Added version and update-date information beside the atlas title.
Replaced the single duration chart with stacked timelines showing selected intervals and dimmed siblings.
Simplified the time navigator, titles, and inline interval duration; removed redundant subdivision cards.
Refined taxon labels and expanded the catalog to 50 profiles.
Introduced hierarchical exploration of geologic eons, eras, periods, epochs, and selected stages.
Added interval overviews spanning etymology, climate, continents, geology, and life.
Introduced clickable taxon profiles with simplified cladograms, traits, examples, and illustrations.
